name: Celestial armor
description: celestial armor of polished platinum: two sculpted domed plates of ornate pierced filigree that fully cover each breast, joined at the centre by a jewelled ornament set with a pearl-white gem, and a matching ornate hip piece with a hanging front panel and a curved plate at each hip, every surface engraved with rolling waves, scallop shells and moon-tide arcs with tiny pearls; each piece hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and floating freely; midriff, shoulders and arms bare
notes: Enchanter / Water. Signature earned armor: filigree plates fully covering the bust and hips, held by magic, motif drawn from her class and element.
